<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a login for SFTP, FTPS and the S3-compatible endpoint.

Everything is optional. With an empty body you get a generated name, a generated password that
satisfies your organization's password policy, a home directory of `/home/{UserName}`, and
`Permission: none` — connectable, but able to read nothing. In practice you almost always want
to set `Permission`.

**The response is the only time a generated password is returned as part of creation.** You can
read it again later with the get or list endpoints, since we store it, but capture it now if
you are handing it to someone.

Counts against your plan's credential limit.
